reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: ATP/load angular study with parallel bulk ATP turnover, step/continuous model comparison and proposed load-based force-mechanism inference.

checks.reason: No explicit proposal to consult/check prior primary Methods or a validated protocol for detailed pre-execution conditions and transfer. Recording unknown settings and developing an assay locally do not satisfy this distinct requirement.

The core immobilization/shaft attachment, solution chemistry (including nucleotide/free-magnesium conditions), recording settings and load manipulation lack an executable quantitative workflow or a concrete calibration-to-setting procedure. Lists of parameters to select later are insufficient.

checks.quote: three times the angular localization precision
checks.reason: Static 3-sigma and ten-frames-per-dwell rules help, but no full false-step/recovery calibration under motion blur/compliance or valid surface-corrected drag calibration is provided.

checks.quote: chambers are technical replicates nested within molecules
checks.reason: The nesting is reversed: molecules share chambers/preparations. No independent preparation replication or power/precision target is supplied, so random molecule effects alone cannot correct the design.

Eligibility explicitly excludes immobile/stuck/nonrotating molecules and requires stable rotation. This discards relevant biological load effects without original denominators; turnover/rotation disagreement also triggers stopping instead of retaining a possible uncoupling result.

checks.quote: 95% credible interval excludes the continuous model
checks.reason: A credible interval does not exclude a discrete model class without an explicitly defined encompassing parameter/model-probability framework. Sequential stopping on this undefined rule and generic hierarchical models do not provide the promised calibrated comparison.

ATP/load/acquisition optimization is not bounded by an explicit ladder or objective range-derivation/search-stop rule before the lock. A promise to select a spanning range from pilots is not a fully specified exploration policy.
Pilot separation and troubleshooting are described, but technical changes do not explicitly trigger a revised freeze and fresh independent confirmatory data under a defined change-control policy.

Bulk ATP consumption and imaged step rate are compared without active-motor/total-enzyme attribution. A near-one ratio cannot establish per-motor coupling, and a varying ratio cannot establish probabilistic coupling; nonrotating enzyme consumption is unaddressed.

Load-invariant steps/longer dwells versus increased backward motion do not uniquely distinguish power strokes from Brownian ratchets. Tightly coupled ratchets can step regularly; both classes can backstep. The proposed key mechanistic discrimination is non-identifying.
No full raw movie/trajectory/calibration manifest with unit identifiers, analysis versions/settings and all excluded/failed records is specified.

historical_match_reason: Step question/mechanism and ATP/load intervention align. There is no torque-angle work and actual hydrolysis-free-energy comparison, and bulk-turnover attribution is not resolved. The full historical readout/prediction is therefore missing; no requirement to guess 120 degrees was imposed.
